description: List read-only HeyClaude entries with bounded pagination and optional category, platform, tag, and query filters.

claimStatus.description: Filter by claim or verification status ('unclaimed', 'pending', 'verified', or 'all').

downloadTrust.description: Filter by package download trust level ('first-party', 'external', 'none', or 'all').

hasPrivacyNotes.description: Filter by whether entries include privacy notes ('true', 'false', or 'all').

hasSafetyNotes.description: Filter by whether entries include safety notes ('true', 'false', or 'all').

limit.description: Number of entries per page (1–25, default 20).

offset.description: Pagination offset for large result sets (0–5000).

platform.description: Filter to entries compatible with this platform.

query.description: Keyword search to narrow the listing.

sourceStatus.description: Filter by whether the entry's source URL is reachable ('available', 'missing', or 'all').

tag.description: Filter to entries carrying this exact tag.

name: registry.list
